content.title: What time does the Masters start today? Tee times, leaderboard
content.text: The 90th Masters Tournament is underway and runs through Sunday, April 12 at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia.Defending champion Rory McIlroy was tied for the lead after the first round, and Australian native and Ohio resident Jason Day was in the top 10, according to USA TODAY. Two-time winner Scottie Scheffler is among many top players competing for the Masters' iconic green jacket, which is made in Cincinnati. Here's how fans can watch the Masters this weekend.AdvertisementHow to watch and live stream the 2026 Masters this weekendWeekend coverage on both Saturday and Sunday begins at noon ET on Paramount+ before airing on CBS from 2–7 p.m. ET.Amazon Prime Video streams the Masters on April 9–10 from 1–3 p.m. ET, followed by ESPN coverage from 3–7:30 p.m. ET. Fans can also live stream coverage for free through the Masters App and Masters.com, as well as via Fubo, which currently offers a free trial subscription for new users.Third round broadcast schedule on Saturday, April 11CBS: 2-7 p.m.ESPN Deportes: 5-6 p.m.The full daily broadcast schedule is available on the Masters' official website.USA TODAY offers a live Masters leaderboard that shows scores, course progress and upcoming tee times for the current round.AdvertisementWeekend tee times are determined by overall score. The list of tee times for Rounds 3 and 4 will appear on the Masters website.This article originally appeared on The Columbus Dispatch: Who is playing in the Masters today?
